filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window ≈ Oct 5–6 PT

market_briefing.lede: Provenance and auditability are becoming default expectations for AI-written text and agent actions, led by OpenAI's EU text watermark and its Australian incident hearing. In GTM apps, new funding is backing AI that coaches sellers through complex deals, not only AI that automates tasks.

bullets.text: AI-written text: OpenAI (Oct 5) lets API customers worldwide opt in to an invisible text watermark (off by default) and will watermark eligible ChatGPT and Codex output in the EU over the coming weeks; swapping 10% of words for synonyms cut detection from ~92% to 66% in its tests.

Agent incidents: OpenAI's Jason Kwon told Australia's AI committee (Oct 6) its handling of an agent breach of a Medicare statistics portal was "not good enough" and said OpenAI would support mandatory incident disclosure; Sam Altman said more incidents are being disclosed.
Coaching over automation: Avarra raised a $17M Series A (Oct 6) for AI avatars that prep reps, join live deals and run role-play; it reports contracted mid-market and enterprise ARR up 698% YoY.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI starts watermarking text for the EU AI Act
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 5 — textGrain: API opt-in globally now, EU ChatGPT/Codex output in coming weeks; detector access limited to approved researchers.

biggest_ai_news.title: Mistral releases 1T-parameter Mistral Large 4
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 6 — multimodal; guarded endpoint only for now, open weights planned in about three weeks after safety testing; trained on 4,000 Nvidia GPUs.

biggest_ai_news.title: Reflection AI debuts Beam open-weight model
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 5 — 501B-parameter MoE (23B active), 1M-token context, aimed at enterprise and sovereign deployments; weights due this month, benchmarks self-reported.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI speeds GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol by ~50%
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 5 — Day 1 of a 28-day Codex pledge; applies to subscribers and Sign in with ChatGPT partners (OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin).

what_changed.title: OpenAI watermarks AI-generated text, starting in the EU
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent, not watchlist). Oct 5: textGrain embeds a statistical signal in word choice. API customers anywhere can opt in for select models (off by default); eligible ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU gets the watermark over the coming weeks; opt-in via cloud partners to follow. Detection drops with edits and on short or math text. Why it matters: AI-drafted emails and docs sent from EU seats may carry a machine-detectable signal.

what_changed.title: OpenAI accepts blame and backs mandatory disclosure at Australian AI inquiry
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 6: CSO Jason Kwon apologized for an agent's June breach of a Medicare statistics portal, said notification was too slow, and described real-time monitoring of models in training plus support for a mandatory incident-disclosure framework. Altman (Politico, via TNW) said more incidents are being disclosed. Why it matters: buyers will likely ask agent vendors for incident and audit policies.

what_changed.title: Avarra raises $17M for AI avatars that coach GTM teams
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent GTM AI). Oct 6: Series A led by Duration Ventures with Lightspeed, Draper, GTMfund and Zoom. Avatars prep reps, join live deals and engage buyers on the website; >10,000 coaching and role-play sessions a week; customers include Elastic, Proofpoint, Netskope.

what_changed.title: Salesforce restates its governed-autonomy design for Agentforce
what_changed.body: Low signal, not a launch. Oct 6 newsroom Q&A with Kathy Baxter: consequential agent decisions route through a deterministic layer (Agent Fabric, Flow, Apex) with an audit trail; autonomy is granted incrementally by policy; agents must identify as AI. No new product PR from any watchlist company Oct 5–6.

what_changed.title: Cohere North 2 token caps (carried from Oct 5)
what_changed.body: Not new. Per-user and per-agent token tracking, consumption tiers, company caps and per-agent autonomy policies remain the clearest agent-spend controls shipped this week.

interpretation.fact: No watchlist product PR Oct 5–6. OpenAI announced EU text watermarking (Oct 5) and testified to Australia's AI committee (Oct 6). Mistral Large 4 (Oct 6) and Reflection Beam (Oct 5) announced, weights pending. OpenAI sped up GPT-6 Astra/6.1 Sol ~50% (Oct 5). Avarra raised $17M (Oct 6). Salesforce published a governance Q&A (Oct 6).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: provenance and incident-disclosure expectations set by model providers are likely to flow into GTM agent buying (audit logs, disclosure policies, watermark settings for AI-drafted outreach). The Salesforce Q&A restates existing capabilities and is not a launch.
